48.original: Ah, adventurer, you couldn't have come at a better time! The preparations for restoring the ward are in place, I'm pleased to report, and with our practiced efficiency, we've established a base camp on practically the doorstep of the Students' headquarters!

49.original: Now, in keeping with tradition, the region in which the camp lies has been given a name: Hydatos, a reference to its watery disposition. Gods willing, this will be last corner of the island that the expedition will need to contend with.

50.original: But without further ado, let me know when you are ready to head over. Mistress Krile is very keen to resume her efforts with your help!

51.original: You now have access to the Forbidden Land, Eureka Hydatos. Like Anemos, Pagos, and Pyros, Hydatos can be explored in parties of up to eight players, or solo.

52.original: To embark on your journey to Hydatos, speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane.

53.original: Please be advised that all excursions into <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8032C03>, are item level synced. Gear exceeding an item level of <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8021503> will be adjusted.
